name: InstaBox
description: Cloud Linux machine for AI agents and developers, running on Firecracker microVMs with Docker and common toolchains preinstalled. Free plan: one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine, 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress per month, no credit card required. Not a persistent VPS: a free machine pauses after 30 minutes idle and runs at most 8 hours per session.
